name: R5 M5 Moon Crystal Guardian Sword

system.description:
[Trigger: Text & Fate 1] Used when you remove a BS. Select one from the BS you just removed and give it to a target that is "Single/Range: 2Sq" from you. A short sword that reflects light like the moon. It is equipped with a strong defense against curses, and those who attempt to harm its wielder are lured into the two holes.

[Core Material](80G)+ (90G)+ (60G)×2+[ 5](40G)×2+Crafting Cost(180G)
